exclusionsNote: Eight explicitly named nonadministrative water/forest features are not assigned to a district. Their footprint remains outside the derived administrative coverage; no missing area is guessed or filled.

simplification.algorithm: GEOS coverage Visvalingam-Whyatt per nearby connected coverage group, retaining every region and island; halve scalar tolerance until each administrative unit has <0.9% symmetric area difference and retained holes

countryCoverage.note: All 522 source features equal the source national outline; the eight named exclusions remain unassigned. Angular-coordinate measures are not land-area claims.

nationalDisplay.note: Province reconstruction exactly equals the district union BEFORE this separately measured national-display generalization. All 38 identities are retained.

encoding.arcLayout: one closed ring per arc; fixed-point delta encoding, no further coordinate loss
